scalars.scalar_value: Previous experience in facilities, maintenance, athletics, recreation, event setup, custodial work, or a related area.

items.item_text: High school diploma or equivalent
Previous experience in facilities, maintenance, athletics, recreation, event setup, custodial work, or a related area.
Experience working in a collegiate or educational environment
Assist the Athletics Facilities Strategist with the day-to-day preparation and upkeep of Athletics facilities.
Prepare athletic spaces for practices, competitions, camps, meetings, rentals, and other scheduled activities.
Assist with opening, closing, and securing Athletics facilities as assigned.
Perform routine walkthroughs of facilities and report maintenance, safety, cleanliness, or equipment concerns to the Facilities Strategist.
Help ensure athletic spaces are returned to their appropriate condition following use.
Assist with maintaining clean, organized, and professional-looking Athletics facilities.
Assist with setup and breakdown for athletic practices, competitions, camps, rentals, and department events.
Move and arrange tables, chairs, benches, barriers, signage, equipment, trash receptacles, and other items as directed.
Assist with preparing team areas, spectator areas, entrances, courts, fields, and other spaces for scheduled use.
Return equipment and facility items to designated storage locations following events or activities.
Perform light cleaning and custodial tasks when needed to maintain facility readiness.
Pick up trash and debris in Athletics facilities and surrounding areas.
Assist with cleaning athletic surfaces, equipment, team areas, storage areas, and other Athletics spaces as assigned.
Monitor restrooms, common areas, team rooms, and other Athletics spaces and communicate needs to the Facilities Strategist.
Assist with periodic facility clean-up and organization projects.
Identify and report damaged equipment, facility concerns, safety hazards, or maintenance needs.
Assist the Athletics Facilities Strategist with minor maintenance tasks that do not require specialized training or a licensed trade.
Assist with basic projects such as replacing signage, organizing storage, assembling equipment, moving furnishings, and other routine facility improvements.
Help receive, move, organize, and store facility supplies and equipment.
Assist with inventory of facility equipment and supplies as requested.
Provide facility-related support for home athletic competitions under the direction of the Athletics Facilities Strategist.
Assist with physical facility readiness before events and restoration of facilities following events.
Provide facility support for Athletics camps, rentals, and special events as assigned.
Work cooperatively with Athletics staff, coaches, student employees, and other University departments while completing assigned facility responsibilities.
Complete assigned tasks safely, efficiently, and within established timelines.
Communicate facility problems or safety concerns promptly.
Demonstrate dependability and punctuality for scheduled shifts.
Maintain a professional and service-oriented approach when interacting with students, employees, guests, and community members.
Demonstrate a commitment to serving and inspiring students and colleagues in a context of a Christian University, integrating your Christian faith into your role and responsibilities.

Embrace the mission, vision , and values of Fresno Pacific University, affirm the FPU Faith Expectations (Download PDF reader) , and support the ideals and practices articulated in " The Fresno Pacific Idea ”
Uphold and advance Fresno Pacific University’s commitment to Christ-centered higher education, holistic student development, and serving diverse communities.
Complete tasks timely with work that is comprehensive, complete, and accurate
Communicates clearly, listens attentively, and seeks to understand others
Collaborates productively with colleagues of varying skillset
Other job duties as assigned
Dependable, punctual, and able to manage assigned responsibilities
Willingness to work a flexible schedule that may include occasional evenings or weekends
Familiarity with athletic facilities or athletic equipment
Indoors in a normal office environment with little exposure to excessive noise, dust, fumes, vibrations, and temperature changes at least eighty percent (80%) of the time.
Frequent computer use at a workstation, up to eight hours per day.
Frequently work at a fast pace with unscheduled interruptions.
Drive personal or University vehicles to appointments.
Public contact position requiring professional apparel, personal hygiene, and grooming.
This position typically functions indoors in an office environment with light to moderate noise associated with business office equipment. The position may involve travel for meetings and events.
Reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities will be provided in accordance with law.
Ability to follow verbal and written instructions
Ability to work independently after receiving direction and as part of a team
Ability to perform hands-on facility and setup work

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: remain in a stationary position 80 % of the time, be able to move about inside the office to access file cabinets/office machinery etc., operate a computer and keyboard and other office productivity machinery such as calculators/copy machines/printers. The employee is occasionally required to position self to reach items on the floor and in high cabinetry.

The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Employee must be able to communicate with others to exchange information including both over the telephone and in-person communication with callers and community members and be able to read a computer screen and paper documents.
